packet.headline_seed: Democrat Graham Platner suspends campaign for key US Senate race after assault allegation
packet.description_seed: The decision came days after a woman accused him of sexual assault, an accusation he says is "categorically false".

what: Democrat Graham Platner suspends campaign for key US Senate race after assault allegation

clean_source_blocks.text: Watch: Graham Platner announces he’s dropping out of Maine’s US Senate race Democrat Graham Platner has suspended his campaign for US Senate in Maine, following a series of scandals that included a woman accusing him of sexual assault. In the days since the accusation was made, Democrats have called on him to drop out of the race considered pivotal to their chances of gaining control of the US Senate. In a video posted online, Platner said his decision was not an admission of guilt but due to Democrats' threats to cut off campaign support. He called the assault allegation "false". He said he would officially file to withdraw from the race once he's assured his replacement in the race against Republican Susan Collins is selected in a "transparent and democratic" way.

Graham Platner has said that he plans to withdraw from the US Senate race in Maine after facing an allegation of sexual assault, shuttering an insurgent campaign that had withstood months of controversy only to implode and imperil Democrats' attempt to regain power in Washington. "We believe that for the movement to continue, it can't be me and for that reason, we are suspending campaign operations," he said in a video posted on X on Wednesday. In the clip, Platner also denied sexual assault allegations that sparked recent calls for him to leave the race. Maine resident who previously dated Platner, accused him of forcing her to have sex in late 2021 despite her repeated objections. His campaign rapidly lost support across the Democratic Party, from the Washington establishment to progressive lawmakers and activists who had previously defended him.
The decision came days after a woman accused him of sexual assault, an accusation he says is "categorically false".

Like nature, politics abhors a vacuum. The state of Maine has an excess of both. On Wednesday night, a pleasant if unremarkable house in the village of Sullivan had attracted a small gathering of news reporters. Hours earlier, its occupant, the Democratic senatorial candidate Graham Platner, had announced his intention to quit the race just days before the July deadline. He did so in a video glumly and trenchantly denying a series of allegations made against him by a number of women, the most recent of whom, Jenny Racicot, gave a harrowing and detailed account of a sexual assault that occurred at her home five years ago. “For the movement to continue, it can’t be me and for that reason, we are suspending campaign operations,” he said on Wednesday.

Democrat Graham Platner has suspended his campaign for US Senate in Maine, following a series of scandals that included a woman accusing him of sexual assault.

In the days since the accusation was made, Democrats have called on him to drop out of the race considered pivotal to their chances of gaining control of the US Senate.

In a video posted online, Platner said his decision was not an admission of guilt but due to Democrats' threats to cut off campaign support. He called the assault allegation "false".

He said he would officially file to withdraw from the race once he's assured his replacement in the race against Republican Susan Collins is selected in a "transparent and democratic" way.

"We're suspending campaign operations," he said in an 11-minute video posted to X, adding that he would file his paperwork to withdraw only after he was assured the process to replace him would be "open and democratic moving forward".

Platner added that he is not "trying to dictate to anyone who it should be or how we get there".

"But I will say this: it needs to be open, transparent, and democratic. It needs to be reflecting the will and the values of the people that built this movement," he said.

On Wednesday night, a pleasant if unremarkable house in the village of Sullivan had attracted a small gathering of news reporters. Hours earlier, its occupant, the Democratic senatorial candidate Graham Platner, had announced his intention to quit the race just days before the July deadline. He did so in a video glumly and trenchantly denying a series of allegations made against him by a number of women, the most recent of whom, Jenny Racicot, gave a harrowing and detailed account of a sexual assault that occurred at her home five years ago.

“For the movement to continue, it can’t be me and for that reason, we are suspending campaign operations,” he said on Wednesday.

“This is incredibly difficult because I know that some will think of it as an admission of guilt. We’re not doing it because of the allegations; we are doing it because of the structures that are being taken away from us by those in power. We did it the right way. We built a campaign. We engaged in electoral politics. We motivated people. We banded together. We did it the way we were told to make a change and we won. But now they are not going to let us count. Not if it’s me.”

payload.title: Graham Platner keskeyttää senaattikampanjansa Mainessa seksuaalirikossyytöksen jälkeen
payload.summary: Demokraatti Graham Platner on ilmoittanut keskeyttävänsä kampanjansa Mainen senaattorikisassa sen jälkeen, kun häntä vastaan esitettiin seksuaalista väkivaltaa koskeva syytös. Platner kiistää syytöksen ja sanoo vetäytymisen johtuvan puolueen tuen menettämisestä.
payload.content:
Demokraattien Graham Platner on ilmoittanut keskeyttävänsä kampanjansa Yhdysvaltain senaattiin Mainen osavaltiossa sen jälkeen, kun häntä vastaan esitettiin seksuaalista väkivaltaa koskeva syytös. Platner kiistää syytöksen jyrkästi ja sanoo, ettei päätös merkitse syyllisyyden myöntämistä.

## Paine kasvoi puolueen sisällä

Platner kertoi verkkovideolla keskeyttävänsä kampanjatoimintansa. Hän sanoi, että liikkeen jatkuminen ei voi enää rakentua hänen ehdokkuutensa varaan. Päätös tuli sen jälkeen, kun demokraattien sisältä oli vaadittu häntä jättämään kisa.

Mainen senaattorikilpailua pidetään demokraateille tärkeänä, koska puolue tavoittelee valtaa Yhdysvaltain senaatissa. Platnerin kampanja oli jo aiemmin selvinnyt useista kohuista, mutta tuore syytös johti nopeasti laajaan tuen katoamiseen puolueessa. Tukea vetäytyi sekä Washingtonin puoluejohdon suunnalta että progressiivisilta poliitikoilta ja aktivisteilta, jotka olivat aiemmin puolustaneet häntä.

Platner sanoi videolla, että hänen päätöksensä liittyy demokraattien uhkauksiin katkaista kampanjatuki. Hän ilmoitti aikovansa jättää virallisen vetäytymisilmoituksen, kunhan on varmistunut siitä, että hänen tilalleen republikaani Susan Collinsia vastaan valittava ehdokas nimetään avoimella ja demokraattisella tavalla.

## Syytös kiistetään

Syytöksen esitti mainelainen nainen, joka oli aiemmin seurustellut Platnerin kanssa. Hänen mukaansa Platner pakotti hänet seksiin loppuvuonna 2021, vaikka hän vastusti sitä toistuvasti. Erään kuvauksen mukaan viimeisin syytöksen esittänyt nainen, Jenny Racicot, kertoi yksityiskohtaisesti seksuaalisesta väkivallasta, jonka hän sanoo tapahtuneen hänen kotonaan viisi vuotta sitten.

Platner kiistää seksuaalista väkivaltaa koskevan syytöksen ja on luonnehtinut sitä kategorisesti vääräksi. Hän myös torjui videollaan häntä vastaan esitettyjä väitteitä samalla kun ilmoitti kampanjansa keskeyttämisestä.

## Seuraava ehdokas ratkaisematta

Mainen demokraateille päätös avaa kiireellisen kysymyksen siitä, kuka jatkaa kilpailua Collinsia vastaan. Platnerin mukaan uusi ehdokas on valittava tavalla, joka säilyttää prosessin legitimiteetin ja antaa puolueelle mahdollisuuden jatkaa vaalikamppailua.
summary_bullets: Graham Platner keskeyttää kampanjansa Mainen senaattorikisassa.
Päätös seurasi seksuaalista väkivaltaa koskevaa syytöstä, jonka Platner kiistää.
Mainen kisaa pidetään demokraateille tärkeänä senaatin valtasuhteiden kannalta.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu packetin neljään lähdeblokkiin. Syytös on käsitelty väitteenä, ja Platnerin kiistäminen on mukana tasapainon vuoksi.
